title: The Ice Cream Van At 3AM (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine it's the hottest night of the year. You can't sleep.
Then you hear it. The ice cream van song. At three a.m.
You look out the window. There it is, parked under the only street lamp.
The lights are on. The little window is open.
You grab some coins. Because, honestly, ice cream at three a.m.? Yes.
The man inside has a big friendly smile. "What flavour, buddy?"
You look at the menu. Vanilla. Chocolate. Strawberry.
And at the bottom, one you've never seen. "Your Favourite Memory."
It tastes like your seventh birthday. Like your grandma's kitchen. It's perfect.
In the morning, your mum asks what you want for your birthday.
She shows you a photo. You, age seven, blowing out candles.
*You've never seen that photo in your life. You don't remember any of it.
And outside, very softly, the ice cream song starts again.
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
